dialogues.speaker: Tia
dialogues.text: *sigh* Why won't the grownups let us go up to roof?

dialogues.speaker: Tia
dialogues.text: There was a little girl just now who wanted to go up to the roof to see the fireworks, but that green-haired guy next to her wouldn't allow it...

dialogues.speaker: Tia
dialogues.text: I heard that they had something else they needed to do... Well, I'm free right now, but Daddy still won't let me up on the roof! What's with that?

dialogues.speaker: Tia
dialogues.text: Are dreams black, or white? Are they another world? I can never remember what happened in my dreams when I wake up.

dialogues.speaker: Tia
dialogues.text: But everyone's saying that if you touch those strange stones, you'll sleep for a long, long time. If I dream for that long, I'll definitely remember my dream, right?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Has traveling been fun?

dialogues.speaker: Tia
dialogues.text: Yup! This is my first time outside Mondstadt. Everything here is so cool!

dialogues.speaker: Tia
dialogues.text: When I was small, I could only read "Vera's Melancholy." I would imagine I was Vera, experiencing all kinds of amazing adventures!

dialogues.speaker: Tia
dialogues.text: I know! I'll give you this copy of "Vera's Melancholy." I might have flipped through it a bit too much...

dialogues.speaker: Tia
dialogues.text: But I don't need it anymore, because I'm on a real adventure with Daddy. My experiences will be even more interesting than the novel!

dialogues.speaker: Tia
dialogues.text: Hello. You must be from somewhere very far away?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's your name?

dialogues.speaker: Tia
dialogues.text: My name is Tia. Landa's my father.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Bye-bye.

dialogues.speaker: Tia
dialogues.text: Bye-bye!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me about your father.

dialogues.speaker: Tia
dialogues.text: My father says I should tell all strangers that he is a traveling merchant.

dialogues.speaker: Tia
dialogues.text: If you're friends with Tia, then I can tell you the truth!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How does one make friends with you, then?

dialogues.speaker: Tia
dialogues.text: Easy, you just need to play with me.

dialogues.speaker: Tia
dialogues.text: But right now I'm playing with Richie and Wei!
